duration.text: The Traffic Engineering at Dalian Maritime University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.Be in good health condition 3.Applicant should be less than 40 4.HSK level 6 or above 5.Graduated with a Bachelor's degree Note: Applicants without HSK certificate (level 6 or above) should attend Mandarin level test of the university,and thosewho get the result equivalent to HSK level 6 or above can be considered.
